function aim(camera: FreeCamera, eye: Vec, target: Vec): void {
  const dx = target.x - eye.x;
  const dy = target.y - eye.y;
  const dz = target.z - eye.z;

  const horizontal = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);

  const yaw = horizontal === 0 ? 0 : Math.atan2(dx, dz);
  const pitch = Math.max(-PITCH_LIMIT, Math.min(PITCH_LIMIT, Math.atan2(dy, horizontal)));

  const scale = distance > 0 ? distance : 1;
  const cosPitch = Math.cos(pitch);
  const aimedTarget: Vec = {
    x: eye.x + Math.sin(yaw) * cosPitch * scale,
    y: eye.y + Math.sin(pitch) * scale,
    z: eye.z + Math.cos(yaw) * cosPitch * scale,
  };

  Object.assign(camera.position, eye);
  Object.assign(camera.target, aimedTarget);
  camera._yaw = yaw;
  camera._pitch = pitch;
}

  scene: SceneContext,
  eye: Vec,
  target: Vec
): Walkthrough {

    jumpTo(eye: Vec, target: Vec): void {
      aim(camera, eye, target);
    },
    dispose(): void {
      if (disposed) return;
      disposed = true;

  };
}

  readonly camera: FreeCamera;

const PITCH_LIMIT = Math.PI / 2 - 0.01;

function setView(camera: FreeCamera, eye: Vec, target: Vec): void {
  const dx = target.x - eye.x;
  const dy = target.y - eye.y;
  const dz = target.z - eye.z;

  const horizontal = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);

  const yaw = horizontal === 0 ? 0 : Math.atan2(dx, dz);
  const pitch = Math.max(-PITCH_LIMIT, Math.min(PITCH_LIMIT, Math.atan2(dy, horizontal)));

  const scale = distance > 0 ? distance : 1;
  const cosPitch = Math.cos(pitch);
  const newTarget: Vec = {
    x: eye.x + Math.sin(yaw) * cosPitch * scale,
    y: eye.y + Math.sin(pitch) * scale,
    z: eye.z + Math.cos(yaw) * cosPitch * scale,
  };

  const newEye: Vec = { x: eye.x, y: eye.y, z: eye.z };
  Object.assign(camera.position, newEye);
  Object.assign(camera.target, newTarget);
  camera._yaw = yaw;
  camera._pitch = pitch;
}

    dispose(): void {

      disposed = true;
      detach();
    },
  };
}
